s.t:
Gestalte mit uns datengetriebene B2B Sales und GTM Strukturen
Du möchtest im Vertrieb nicht nur bestehende Leads bearbeiten, sondern moderne Go to Market Systeme aktiv mitentwickeln? In dieser Rolle verbindest du Business Development mit datenbasiertem Prospecting, AI Tools, automatisierten Workflows und strukturierten Outbound Prozessen.
Gemeinsam mit unserem Sales Director entwickelst du skalierbare Prozesse für ein modernes B2B SaaS Umfeld. Du recherchierst und qualifizierst relevante Zielunternehmen, analysierst Märkte und Ansprechpartner, arbeitest mit CRM und Sales Tools und entwickelst personalisierte Outreach Sequenzen über verschiedene Kanäle.
Neben der operativen Ansprache potenzieller Kunden führst du kurze Discovery Calls, dokumentierst relevante Daten sauber im CRM und unterstützt dabei, Lead Scoring, Datenanreicherung, Automatisierungen und Übergaben an den weiteren Sales Prozess kontinuierlich zu verbessern.
Du passt zu uns, wenn du Vertrieb als Zusammenspiel aus Kommunikation, analytischem Denken, Prozessverständnis und Technologie begreifst und Lust hast, moderne Sales Infrastrukturen aktiv mit aufzubauen.
Aufgaben

s.h: Auf diese spannenden Aufgaben darfst du dich freuen
s.t:
Business Development & Outbound Sales: Du recherchierst und identifizierst relevante Zielunternehmen, erstellst strukturierte und datenbasierte Prospecting-Listen und sprichst potenzielle Kunden gezielt über E-Mail, LinkedIn und Telefon an. Gemeinsam mit unserem Sales Director entwickelst du daraus eine belastbare und skalierbare Sales Pipeline.
Opportunity Development & Qualification: Du führst strukturierte Erstgespräche und Discovery Calls, analysierst Anforderungen, Use Cases und Entscheidungsstrukturen und qualifizierst Opportunities anhand klarer Kriterien für die nächsten Schritte im Sales-Prozess.
AI-gestütztes Prospecting: Du kombinierst moderne Research-Methoden, Datenquellen, Buying Signals und AI-basierte Personalisierung, um passende Zielkunden effizient zu identifizieren, relevante Ansprechpartner zu priorisieren und qualifizierte Gespräche vorzubereiten.
Outreach & Messaging: Du entwickelst zielgruppenspezifische Outreach-Sequenzen und optimierst Messaging, Targeting, Personalisierung und Kanalwahl kontinuierlich auf Basis von Kampagnen-, Engagement- und Performance-Daten.
CRM & Pipeline-Steuerung: Du strukturierst und pflegst HubSpot zuverlässig, dokumentierst Aktivitäten, Kontakte und Opportunities transparent und schaffst damit die Grundlage für eine datenbasierte Steuerung von Outreach, Forecast und Deal-Fortschritten.
Automationen & Go-to-Market-Prozesse: Du unterstützt beim Aufbau und der Weiterentwicklung von Clay-Workflows und verbindest HubSpot, Clay sowie weitere Outreach-, Daten- und GTM-Tools zu effizienten Prospecting- und Automatisierungsprozessen.
Testing & Optimierung: Du konzipierst und testest neue Kampagnen, Sequenzen und Workflows, wertest die Ergebnisse systematisch aus und optimierst Prozesse auf Basis relevanter Kennzahlen, um Effizienz, Datenqualität und Conversion Rates nachhaltig zu verbessern.
Qualifikation

Erfahrung im modernen Business Development: Du bringst 2 bis 5 Jahre Erfahrung im Business Development, SDR Umfeld oder B2B Sales mit. Strukturierte Zielkundenrecherche, Prospecting, Outreach sowie Erstgespräche und Discovery Calls gehören für dich zum Vertriebsalltag.
Sicherheit im modernen GTM Stack: Du hast bereits mit modernen Sales, CRM und GTM Tools gearbeitet, insbesondere mit HubSpot, LinkedIn Sales Navigator sowie Plattformen wie Lemlist, Apollo oder vergleichbaren Lösungen. Idealerweise kennst du auch datenbasierte Workflows zur Recherche, Anreicherung und Priorisierung von Leads.
Kommunikation mit Relevanz: Du kommunizierst klar, präzise und zielgruppengerecht, schriftlich wie mündlich. Du verstehst, wie personalisierte Ansprache, relevante Trigger und überzeugendes Messaging im modernen Outbound zusammenspielen.
Struktur, Ownership und Lernbereitschaft: Du arbeitest strukturiert, eigenständig und mit hohem Verantwortungsbewusstsein. Gleichzeitig bist du bereit, dich schnell in neue Tools, Datenquellen, Prozesse und technologische GTM Ansätze einzuarbeiten.
Technologie und AI Affinität: Du interessierst dich für moderne Prospecting und Go to Market Prozesse und verstehst den Mehrwert von AI gestütztem Research, automatisierter Datenanreicherung, Personalisierung und datenbasiertem Outbound. Erste Erfahrungen mit Clay, Workflow Automationen oder vergleichbaren Tools sowie Kenntnisse aus SaaS oder Startup Umfeldern sind ein Plus.
Wichtig für uns: Du musst kein fertiger GTM oder Automatisierungsprofi sein. Entscheidend ist, dass du moderne Outbound Prozesse verstehst, gerne mit Kunden sprichst, strukturiert mit Daten und Tools arbeitest und Lust hast, Sales, Technologie und skalierbare GTM Prozesse miteinander zu verbinden.

Mehr als nur ein spannender und abwechslungsreicher Job
Direkte Zusammenarbeit mit unserem Sales Director: Du arbeitest eng mit unserem Sales Director zusammen und erhältst tiefe Einblicke in Vertriebsstrategie, Go to Market, Pipeline Aufbau und skalierbares Wachstum.
Flexibles Arbeiten: Ob remote oder hybrid, wir setzen auf Eigenverantwortung und schaffen ein Arbeitsumfeld, das konzentriertes Arbeiten, digitale Zusammenarbeit und Flexibilität sinnvoll miteinander verbindet.
Attraktives Vergütungsmodell: Dich erwartet ein attraktives Fixgehalt in Kombination mit einem performanceabhängigen Bonusmodell und einem OTE von bis zu 70.000 Euro, abhängig von deiner Erfahrung und dem Umfang deiner Verantwortung.
Gestaltungsfreiraum statt starrer Prozesse: Du bringst eigene Ideen ein, entwickelst Prospecting, Outreach und GTM Prozesse aktiv weiter und gestaltest mit, wie unsere Sales Infrastruktur und Revenue Engine langfristig aufgebaut werden.
Hohe Eigenverantwortung: Du übernimmst vom ersten Tag an Verantwortung für eigene Themen, Kampagnen und Prozesse. Wir vertrauen auf Eigeninitiative, eine strukturierte Arbeitsweise und schnelle Umsetzung.
Moderner GTM und AI Stack: Du arbeitest mit modernen Sales, Daten und Automatisierungstools wie HubSpot, Clay, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, Lemlist, Apollo sowie weiteren Lösungen für Research, Datenanreicherung, Prospecting und Outreach.
Performanceorientierte Kultur: Wir arbeiten ambitioniert, datenbasiert und mit einem klaren Fokus auf messbare Ergebnisse. Gute Ideen, Ownership, saubere Prozesse und kontinuierliche Optimierung zählen bei uns mehr als Hierarchien oder Titel.
Direkte Kommunikation und schnelle Entscheidungswege: Wir arbeiten pragmatisch, transparent und mit kurzen Abstimmungswegen. Entscheidungen werden schnell getroffen, neue Ansätze zügig getestet und Ergebnisse direkt in die weitere Optimierung überführt.
Noch wichtig: Auch wenn du bei uns vollständig remote arbeitest, muss sich dein dauerhafter Arbeitsort in Deutschland befinden. Arbeiten aus dem Ausland ist in dieser Position nicht möglich.

Uber for Business is looking for a sharp, highly motivated Enterprise Account Executive to join our team, focusing on the CPG, Retail, and Heavy Industry verticals. This is a role for a \"hunter\" who can navigate the complex, often messy world of large-scale corporate logistics and turn ambiguity into growth.

You won't just be selling a platform; you'll be reimagining how the largest companies in the region move their employees and goods-from late-night shift commutes to high-volume voucher campaigns for the automotive industry.
Working here means solving high-stakes problems in real-time. You'll need to balance short-term execution sprints with a long-term vision for whitespace accounts with over 5,000 employees. The pace is fast, and the expectations for ownership are higher.

Success requires a blend of strategic thinking to break into new territories and the grit to push through long, multi-stakeholder contract negotiations. If you're energized by the challenge of tailoring consumer-loved products like Rides and Eats into mission-critical business solutions, this is where you'll grow.

Own and exceed aggressive sales targets by creatively prospecting into Enterprise accounts with 5,000+ employees, identifying decision-makers, and uncovering hidden business drivers.
Develop and execute robust territory and account plans to break into whitespace accounts, managing the end-to-end sales cycle from qualification to contract negotiation and closing.
Listen deeply to customer pain points and craft winning narratives that align the Uber for Business value proposition with their specific operational needs.
Forecast and manage your sales pipeline with high accuracy using Salesforce CRM, ensuring consistent activity and lead velocity.
Coordinate cross-functionally with Marketing, Operations, and Implementation leads to ensure every account launch is \"A+\" and delivers immediate value.
Navigate and unblock complex negotiations with Procurement, Finance, and HR leaders to position Uber as a critical infrastructure partner.

5+ years of B2B sales experience in a client-facing role, ideally within a SaaS or high-growth technology environment.
Proven track record of exceeding revenue targets and managing complex sales cycles within Large Corporations/Enterprise segments.
Proficiency in using Salesforce CRM for pipeline management and forecasting.
Demonstrated ability to conduct strategic territory and account planning.
Advanced English proficiency and Portuguese fluency.

Deep understanding of the CPG, Retail, or Heavy Industry landscape in Brazil.
Experience selling consumption-based technology or \"Anything-as-a-Service\" (XaaS) solutions.
Established relationships with Travel Directors, Commute Managers, or Procurement leaders in the Enterprise segment.
Experience with a structured sales framework or methodology (e.g., MEDDIC, Challenger).
Resilience and a \"builder\" mindset with the ability to navigate market adversity and ongoing product development.
Ready to Ride?
This isn't the kind of place where you follow a playbook - it's where you help write one. If you're driven by impact, energized by challenge, and ready to shape how the world moves - we'd love to hear from you.

Who We Are: Interra Health is a fast-growing healthcare technology company transforming how providers and patients navigate the prescription journey.

Formed through the merger of DoseSpot, Arrive Health, and pVerify, Interra Health delivers trusted eligibility, real-time coverage and pricing insights, prescribing tools, and pharmacy transparency at the point of care—helping providers make informed decisions and patients access the right medications with greater clarity and affordability.

Backed by strong market momentum and a bold vision for the future of connected care, Interra Health offers the chance to join an innovative, mission-driven team working at the intersection of software and healthcare to reduce friction, improve access, and make the healthcare experience better for everyone.

The Role: The Lead Account Manager is a strategic, customer-facing player-coach responsible for managing a portfolio of high-value accounts while helping build a more consistent and scalable account management function across Interra Health.

This role may support either DoseSpot or pVerify based on business need and is expected to evolve as the company continues moving toward a unified, segment-based account management model.

The role reports to the Head of Account Management and partners closely with Sales, Product, Support, Marketing, and Operations to improve retention, strengthen executive relationships, and create clearer visibility into customer health, risk, adoption, and growth opportunities across the segment.

Key Responsibilities: Own a portfolio of high-value accounts with full accountability for retention, growth, and executive relationship management — including business reviews, renewal planning, and C-suite engagement. Coach Account Managers and Senior Account Managers on customer planning, risk mitigation, stakeholder mapping, and growth strategy.

Own proactive outreach to the segment book when new products or features roll out — not waiting for clients to discover them; field objections, clear escalation blockers, track adoption, and flag at-risk accounts to the Head of Account Management.

Lead joint planning conversations with customers to uncover growth opportunities and deepen platform adoption. Build and maintain segment-level reporting on customer health, renewal risk, adoption trends, expansion opportunities, and account-level goals — including ARR growth, usage trends, and health scores — for use in executive communications.

Surface friction points — product gaps, support patterns, onboarding challenges — in a data-informed way that drives action across the business. Serve as the primary voice of the customer for the segment, contributing structured insights to roadmap, packaging, and go-to-market decisions.

Partner with the Head of Account Management to develop consistent AM processes, playbooks, forecasting practices, and operating rhythms. Partner cross-functionally with Product, Support, Sales, Marketing, and Operations to advocate for customer needs and manage complex escalations.

Support the transition from product-based to segment-based account management, helping shape structure and process along the way.

AI Expectations: Leverage AI-enabled tools to improve customer health monitoring, streamline reporting workflows, surface renewal risk earlier, and increase the speed and quality of insights delivered to internal stakeholders and customers.

Familiarity with tools such as ChatGPT or Claude is a plus; candidates who use AI thoughtfully to improve execution, prioritization, and decision-making will be well positioned for success in this role.

What You’ll Bring: Degree & Years of Experience: Typically requires 7+ years of experience in Account Management, Customer Success, or a similar post-sale commercial role, along with a Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience.

Knowledge & Application: Brings deep knowledge of account management practices, customer health methodologies, and SaaS commercial models, ideally in healthcare technology. Operates independently, prioritizes effectively across a complex portfolio, and exercises sound judgment in managing renewals, customer risk, and growth opportunities.

Complexity & Problem Solving: Navigates complex, multi-stakeholder customer situations involving renewal risk, product limitations, organizational change, or competitive pressure. Identifies patterns across accounts and translates them into scalable solutions, process improvements, and escalation priorities.

Creates practical frameworks and reporting approaches where they do not yet exist. Collaboration & Interaction: Works cross-functionally with Product, Sales, Support, Marketing, Operations, and executive leadership.

Coaches others while owning a strategic book of business and serves as a key conduit between the field and leadership by translating customer and segment signals into actionable recommendations.

Working Conditions & Environment: Fully remote role within the United States Periodic travel (approximately 15-25%) for customer meetings, team events, and industry conferences Operates in a fast-paced, growth-oriented, PE-backed SaaS environment Requires strong cross-functional collaboration across Product, Sales, Support, and Executive Leadership Ability to manage a complex portfolio of accounts and shifting organizational priorities simultaneously Success in this role requires strong asynchronous communication, thoughtful prioritization, and comfort operating in a remote-first environment Benefits & Perks: 💸 Competitive compensation 🌍 Remote-first Work from anywhere in US.

We also provide a one-time home office stipend to set up your workspace, plus a monthly Wi-Fi reimbursement.

Flexible work Flexible scheduling and core collaboration hours (10:00 AM – 3:00 PM ET), giving you space for both deep work and real life. ✈ Company-wide offsite We invest in connection—join us for an annual offsite to collaborate, build relationships, and have some fun together. 🌴 Time off that you’re expected to use Flexible PTO designed for real recharge, plus 17 company holidays, paid sick leave, and paid parental leave. 💙 Comprehensive health coverage Choose from multiple medical plan options with significant company premium contributions, along with dental (including orthodontia) and vision coverage for you and your family.

Includes company contributions to HSA/FSA accounts (based on plan selection). 💰 Financial wellness 401(k) with company match to help you plan for the future.

Für unseren Kunden Elephant , ein schnell wachsendes AI-SaaS-Unternehmen, suchen wir einen erfahrenen (Senior) Full Cycle Account Executive (m/w/d) .
Mit Elephants SaaS Lösung haben Frontline Teams jederzeit Zugriff auf Wissen, Schritt-für-Schritt-Anleitungen und KI-gestützte Unterstützung – direkt im Arbeitsalltag. Das spart Zeit, steigert Produktivität und sorgt dafür, dass Menschen ihre Arbeit einfacher und sicherer erledigen können.
Mehr als 90 Unternehmen vertrauen bereits auf Elephant – darunter Enpal, 1KOMMA5°, Hörmann, TÜV Süd, DEKRA, Daimler Trucks und GEA.
Jetzt suchen wir erfahrene Full Cycle Account Executives , die komplexe B2B-SaaS-Deals eigenständig gewinnen und die Go-to-Market-Strategie aktiv mitgestalten möchten.
Deine Mission
Du verantwortest den kompletten Sales Cycle – von der ersten Outbound-Nachricht bis zur Vertragsunterschrift.
Bei uns bekommst du keine vorqualifizierten Opportunities übergeben. Du baust deine Pipeline selbst auf (ca. 70 % Outbound, 30 % Inbound), entwickelst Beziehungen zu Entscheidern und führst komplexe Buying Center sicher bis zum Closing.
Wichtig: Wir verkaufen ein innovatives AI-Produkt an mittelständische und große Unternehmen. Unsere Deals dauern häufig mehrere Monate und beinhalten Geschäftsführung, Fachbereiche, IT, Datenschutz und teilweise Betriebsräte.
Wenn dich komplexe Enterprise-nahe Sales-Prozesse reizen, wirst du hier viel bewegen können.
Aufgaben
Du identifizierst neue Zielkunden und baust deine eigene Pipeline durch strukturiertes Outbound auf.
Du führst Discovery Calls und Produktdemos eigenständig durch.
Du steuerst komplexe Buying Center und entwickelst Champions innerhalb der Kundenorganisation.
Du begleitest Verhandlungen bis zum erfolgreichen Vertragsabschluss.
Du arbeitest eng mit unseren Foundern zusammen und bringst deine Learnings direkt in Produkt, Positionierung und GTM-Prozesse ein.
Du entwickelst neue ICPs, Outbound-Sequenzen und Sales-Prozesse mit und testest kontinuierlich neue Ansätze.
Du repräsentierst Elephant auf Messen, Events und bei Kundenterminen.
Qualifikation
Erfahrung im B2B SaaS Sales als Full Cycle Account Executive.
Du hast Deals selbst gesourct und erfolgreich abgeschlossen.
Erfahrung mit komplexen Sales Cycles über mehrere Monate und unterschiedlichen Stakeholdern.
Nachweisbare Vertriebserfolge (z. B. Quota Attainment, Deal-Größen oder gewonnene Kunden).
Outbound gehört für dich selbstverständlich zum Alltag – Telefon, LinkedIn oder E-Mail.
Du kannst technische Produkte verständlich erklären und bewegst dich sicher im Austausch mit IT-Entscheidern.
AI-Tools gehören für dich selbstverständlich zu deinem Arbeitsalltag.
Du arbeitest eigenverantwortlich, triffst Entscheidungen und fühlst dich in einem dynamischen Start-up-Umfeld wohl.
Verhandlungssicheres Deutsch sowie sehr gute Englischkenntnisse.

Warum Elephant?
Gestalte unseren Vertrieb aktiv mit
Du kommst in einer Phase zu uns, in der wir den Übergang vom Founder-led Sales hin zu einem skalierenden GTM-Team gestalten. Deine Ideen haben direkten Einfluss auf unseren zukünftigen Vertrieb.
Ein Produkt mit echtem Mehrwert
Unsere Software hilft Menschen, die täglich anpacken und unsere Infrastruktur, Industrie und Energiewende vorantreiben.
Direkter Impact
Du arbeitest eng mit den Foundern zusammen. Gute Ideen landen nicht auf einer Warteliste, sondern werden umgesetzt.

Deine Aufgaben
Bring! ist der meistgenutzte Einkaufsbegleiter im DACH-Raum und eine wachsende Werbeplattform für Retail- und FMCG-Marken. Als Strategic Account Executive im New Business bist du verantwortlich dafür, neue Werbepartner zu gewinnen: vom ersten Gespräch bis zur Unterschrift.
Du verkaufst kein Standardprodukt, sondern ein Medienformat, das Marken und Händler im entscheidenden Moment der Kaufentscheidung platziert. Hier setzt du an und vertreibst, problemzentriert und datengesteuert an C-Level und Marketing-Entscheider.
Deine ersten 90 Tage
Onboarding auf Produkt, Ad-Formate und unseren Sales-Prozess (SPICED / Winning by Design)
Eigenständige Übernahme einer bestehenden Liste relevanter Zielkunden
Ramp-Up und qualifizierter Pipeline Aufbau
Erste Deals in der Closing-Phase

Du gewinnst Marken für einen Werbekanal, den es so kein zweites Mal gibt:
Bring! erreicht Menschen nicht beim Scrollen, sondern im Moment der Einkaufsplanung direkt auf dem Einkaufszettel. Du bringst Retail- und FMCG-Marken in genau diesem Moment zu den Bring! User:innen.
Das heißt: Du verkaufst kein austauschbares Banner-Inventar, sondern einen Kanal mit klarem Performance-Versprechen. Deine Aufgabe ist es, das den richtigen Entscheidern verständlich zu machen.

s.h: Du baust dir deinen Markt selbst
s.t:
Du identifizierst, qualifizierst und gewinnst neue Werbepartner, über Outbound, eigene Recherche und B2B-Inbound.
Du navigierst durch komplexe Entscheidungsstrukturen bis dorthin, wo das Budget freigegeben wird: C-Level in Marketing, Media und Category.

s.h: Du gewinnst Deals, die zählen und gibst sie sauber weiter
s.t:
Du führst den kompletten Zyklus von der ersten Discovery bis zur Unterschrift, mit Fokus auf Deals mit echtem Hebel. Du nutzt SPICED nicht als Pflichtprozess, sondern um schneller zum eigentlichen Bedarf zu kommen.
Was du gewinnst, übergibst du strukturiert ans Account Management. Dein Erfolg endet nicht beim Vertragsabschluss, sondern bei einem Kunden, der bleibt.

Du übertriffst deine Monats- und Quartalsziele und deine Pipeline in HubSpot ist sauber genug, dass das niemanden überrascht.
Forecast-Hygiene ist für dich kein Reporting-Zwang, sondern die Grundlage dafür, dass du planbar lieferst.

Du bist am Markt näher dran als jede interne Funktion.
Dein Feedback an Marketing, Product und Sales Ops fließt direkt in unsere Ad-Formate und unser Pricing ein — du verkaufst nicht nur, du formst mit, was du verkaufst.
Dein Profil
Für diese Stelle suchen wir eine proaktive, lösungsorientierte und neugierige Person mit einem Growth Mindset. Du bist bereit, mit deiner Erfahrung ein sehr gutes Sales-Team noch besser zu machen und schätzt eine Kultur der Zusammenarbeit ohne Ellenbogen, dann bist du hier richtig.
Mindestens 3 Jahre Erfahrung im (Media-)Vertrieb, idealerweise in der Retail/FMCG-Branche
Nachweisliche Erfolge beim Aufbau von Pipelines & Abschluss auf Mid- bis C-Level
CRM-Erfahrung (HubSpot bevorzugt) & G2M-Methodik (Winning by Design)
Deutsch verhandlungssicher (C2), Englisch sehr gut
Warum wir?
Bei Bring! Labs setzen wir auf eine offene, professionelle Kultur, in der vielfältige Perspektiven und Hintergründe geschätzt werden. Wir bieten dir einen Arbeitsplatz, an dem du direkt Einfluss nehmen und gleichzeitig deine Karriere weiterentwickeln kannst. Was dich bei uns erwartet:
Attraktives Gehaltspaket (Split: 60/40 | Fix / Variabel)
Ungedeckelter variabler Lohn auf Neukunden-Abschlüsse
Trailing-Provision auf Folgeumsätze des Account Managements (12 Monate)
Hybrides Arbeiten mit 40% Home Office und bis 20 Tage / Jahr “working from abroad”
25 Urlaubstage + freier Tag an deinem Geburtstag
Bahncard 50 und 50 EUR / Monat auf deine Pluxee Karte
Interne und externe Weiterbildungsmöglichkeiten und eigene Sales Academy zum professionellen Wachstum
Wir berücksichtigen Bewerbungen unabhängig von Nationalität, ethnischem Hintergrund, Alter, sexueller Orientierung, Geschlecht, Behinderung oder familiärer Situation. Wir fördern auch die Bewerbungen von Berufsrückkehrern.
Neugierig geworden? Besuche unsere Karriereseite und starte deine Reise mit Bring! Labs - wir freuen uns auf frischen Wind, smarte Ideen und deinen Einsatz bei uns!

Leapsome drives HR excellence and empowers high-performing teams by automating, connecting, and simplifying every HR process across the employee lifecycle — from onboarding and performance management to engagement and development. Built with ease of use in mind, our platform ensures high adoption by employees, managers, and People teams alike.
Our purpose is to make work fulfilling for everyone , and our vision is to reshape the future of work by being the leading People platform for HR excellence and high-performing teams. We enable companies to create environments where people can achieve their goals, learn and grow together, and build genuine motivation & engagement.
Trusted by thousands of organizations globally, Leapsome secured $60 million in Series A funding led by Insight Partners in March 2022. This funding allowed us to further develop our intelligent platform, create exceptional employee experiences, and expand into the US market.
It’s an incredibly exciting time to join Leapsome and be part of reshaping the future of work!
Your Opportunity
Are you curious and eager to learn and grow? Looking for an opportunity to demonstrate and expand your skills in sales? Are you ambitious to create the best possible buyers’ experience? And, passionate to shape the future of work and continuous learning with us? Leapsome offers an exciting opportunity for driven and ambitious people to join our growing team in the heart of Berlin.

Full ownership and all the autonomy needed when it comes to the most critical steps of the sales cycle such as prospecting (including social selling), conducting platform demos, negotiating, and closing (including legal, data, and security).

Stakeholder Management/Relationship building.
Pipeline Management (incl. CRM data hygiene).
Accurate forecasting (incl. probabilities, priority, size, timelines, etc.).
Nurturing postponed/closed lost leads.
Being a product and industry expert (become/sustain needed for consultative selling).
Extracurricular activities (temporary assignments, e.g. OKR initiatives).
Your Profile
You hold a university degree and have 2 - 5 years of work experience in Sales (ideally in B2B SaaS) or a customer-exposed role, e.g., at a consulting firm.
You have a fluent/native level in German + fluency in English.
You excel at asking the right questions to understand a customer’s needs and decision process quickly, and you work with the customer to generate value for them.
You are AI-native, independently leveraging AI in order to maximise your ability to deliver a strong customer experience and streamline your internal process.
You are passionate about the future of work and continuous learning at work, and you want to join us in building an exceptional team and company to have a real impact in this space.
Bonus: You have previous experience in SaaS or HR tech, and/or organizational development, people development, or agility & digitalization.

Learning and development: Grow your skills with a €2,000 yearly development budget and full access to the Good Habitz platform.
Work-from-home stipend: A one-time €1,000 stipend to set up your home workspace.
Competitive pay and equity: Competitive salary plus a pre-IPO equity package, so you share in the company's growth.
Corporate benefits: Exclusive discounts and deals from our partner network.
Vacation: 30 vacation days a year plus public holidays, with the option to upgrade to 40 days at adjusted pay. After 5 years at Leapsome, take a month-long paid sabbatical.
Wellness benefits: Stay active with a fully sponsored Urban Sports Club M membership, and support your mental health with an Oliva subscription that includes 1:1 therapy sessions, plus company workshops on mindfulness and digital wellness.
Hybrid and flexible work: Spend 2 days a week with the team in our Berlin office, Tuesdays and Thursdays.
Impact: Join a fast-growing HR platform trusted by more than 2,000 companies worldwide: you'll help shape how companies run HR and grow their people in one connected system.
Culture: A diverse, international team that values open feedback and celebrates wins, big and small.
Sponsored lunch: Lunch is on us every Tuesday and Thursday.
Work from anywhere: Work from a different location for up to 2 months a year.
Monthly team activities: Join Feierabend , a monthly budget to get-together in Berlin — hosted by employees, for employees.
This role is based in Berlin and the salary range for this position is €55,000 - €85,000 + Bonus + Equity . View our full compensation framework here .
Leapsome aims to pay generously and fairly. If the listed range isn’t working for your situation, please tell us early in the process, we’d rather have that conversation than lose a great candidate over a number we may be able to address.
If your role or skillset isn’t covered in our compensation framework , it’s likely because we haven’t hired enough in that area yet. We’ll build a data-backed range before we make you an offer, and we’ll share our thinking with you as early as we can.
This note is published for transparency. It reflects our compensation philosophy as of June 2026 and describes our general global approach — it is not a contract, offer, or entitlement to any salary, increase, or bonus, and may change at any time. Individual compensation is always governed solely by your written employment agreement and applicable local law.
Leapsome’s values

Impact is everything — We aim high, focus on the outcomes that matter and say no to the rest.

Help us make work fulfilling for everyone!
At Leapsome, we want work to be the best it can be for everyone. We help companies create environments where people can achieve shared goals, build authentic relationships, learn, and grow together.

As our business scales, we need an experienced sales professional to close inbound leads so our experts can focus entirely on delivering world-class client results.

Client Advising: Act as the initial guide for families, diagnosing their specific educational needs and recommending the appropriate level of service (from standard tutoring to elite coaching).
Cross-Selling & Expansion: Leverage our long-term client relationships to cross-sell multiple services across a family's 7-8 year journey with Cardinal Education .

An Educational Insider: You have strong experience in education sales, admissions counseling, EdTech, or any adjacent industry. You understand the nuances of the industry and don't need to be trained on the basics of high-stakes academic metrics.
A Consultative Closer: You excel at high-ticket sales and know how to build credibility and trust quickly with an affluent, demanding clientele.
A Team Player and a Relationship Builder: You are looking for a long-term home to build your career. You understand that in high-stakes education, long-term client success and team collaboration matter far more than just chasing the next quick close.
Systems Oriented: You are comfortable working within CRM systems (like Salesforce) to manage a heavy flow of leads and track pipeline velocity.

Zero Cold Calling: Step into a role with a massive, proven inbound lead pipeline.
High LTV: You aren't just selling one product; you are building a book of business with families that return year after year for new services.
Competitive Compensation: We offer a strong compensation package (OTE range $80k - $120k ) designed to provide stability without the constant "feast or famine" typical of a meat-grinder sales culture.
Remote Flexibility: Live and work where you want. You do not need to be based in the Bay Area.

GT was founded in 2019 by a former Apple, Nest, and Google executive. GT’s mission is to connect the world’s best talent with product careers offered by high-growth companies in the UK, USA, Canada, Germany, and the Netherlands.
On behalf of Vodori , GT is looking for an Account Executive (Enterprise SaaS – Life Sciences) who is excited to drive complex enterprise sales cycles and help leading pharma, biotech, and medtech companies modernize their commercial and compliance infrastructure.
About the Client
Founded in 2005, Vodori is a purpose-built SaaS company helping life sciences organizations accelerate compliant promotional content review. With two decades of experience, Vodori has become the trusted choice for pharmaceutical, medical device, biotech, and diagnostics companies worldwide.
Positioned as a modern, flexible, and cost-effective alternative to legacy systems, Vodori partners closely with Salesforce and other commercial tools, and is rapidly expanding its footprint across enterprise life sciences organizations looking to future-proof their operations.

As an Account Executive, you will own and drive new enterprise revenue by leading complex, multi-stakeholder sales cycles. You will act as a strategic, business-case-led seller who can translate customer pain into measurable impact and guide organizations through meaningful transformation.
You will work closely with SDRs, Marketing, and Leadership to execute a focused go-to-market strategy targeting enterprise pharma and medtech accounts. This role requires a disciplined and consultative approach, with a strong focus on deal qualification, stakeholder alignment, and closing high-value opportunities.

s.h: Owning full-cycle enterprise sales from qualification to close
s.t:
Leading complex, multi-threaded deals across commercial, medical, regulatory, IT, and executive stakeholders
Building and presenting compelling business cases (ROI, cost of inaction)
Running structured discovery and translating customer pain into quantified business impact
Driving pipeline conversion through clear next steps and mutual action plans
Maintaining deal momentum throughout long sales cycles
Developing and executing account strategies for enterprise and upper mid-market clients
Partnering with SDRs on outbound efforts and account coverage
Collaborating with Marketing on campaigns and messaging
Working cross-functionally with Customer Success and Product teams to support deal progression

5–10+ years of SaaS sales experience
Proven track record closing $50K–$250K+ ACV deals
Experience selling into enterprise or upper mid-market accounts
Strong experience managing complex, multi-stakeholder sales cycles
Excellent discovery skills and ability to build business cases
Familiarity with MEDDPICC or similar sales methodologies
Ability to manage long sales cycles and build internal consensus
Strong communication skills with experience selling to executive stakeholders

Experience in life sciences (pharma, biotech, medtech)
Familiarity with MLR, regulatory, or compliance workflows
Experience selling against legacy systems or incumbents
Background in Salesforce ecosystem or partner-led sales
Experience selling platforms that require organizational change management
Experience in scaling SaaS environments

Hiring Manager / Sales Leadership interview
Case study/business case presentation
Final interview with executive leadership

Plan and execute joint go-to-market initiatives in the regions.
Align with field teams and track revenue impact locally.

s.h: THIS IS A REAL STEP INTO CLOSING
s.t:
You booked the meeting. Someone else closed it. Not here.
Your number. Your accounts. Your calls. Your deals. Start to finish.
You already know this feeling
You worked the account for weeks. You found the pain, you got the right person on the phone, you booked the meeting. Then you handed it over and watched someone else take it to signature and pick up the commission.
This is the seat where you keep it.

You own a UK and Ireland mid-market patch and carry a monthly new-business ARR target. You find every opportunity yourself, and you close it yourself. There is no SDR underneath you and nobody filling your diary. We give you the data, the tools, the coaching and a few live opportunities to get you moving. Everything after that is yours to build.
If that reads as a warning, this is not your role. If it reads as an opportunity, keep going.
What you’ll actually be doing
Picking your target accounts and going after them properly
Cold calling. Every week. It does not stop being part of the job when you start closing
Running discovery that reaches business impact, not a feature checklist
Demoing Joblogic to operations directors, finance and business owners
Multi-threading, building the commercial case, negotiating and closing
Keeping HubSpot honest and forecasting a number you are happy to be held to
What we’ll give you
A structured 90-day ramp into discovery, demonstrations, commercials and closing. You will never be guessing what good looks like
Full coaching as standard: MEDDPICC is our qualification standard and we will teach it to you, alongside discovery, demo and negotiation training, weekly call reviews and deal clinics
Live opportunities at the start to get you selling while you build your own engine
The data, tooling and tech stack to prospect properly, so your time goes on selling rather than list building
A real career, with a fast-growing, PE-backed software business scaling to £100M ARR. This is the first seat of a career here, not the last
You’ll love this if
You have 12-36 months as an SDR or BDR and you have smashed your number, and you can prove it with real figures
A cold call that turns into a deal is still the best part of your week
You are competitive with yourself before you are competitive with anyone else
You want feedback, not comfort, and you act on it fast
You want to be judged on ARR, not on dials and diary entries
You are curious about how businesses actually make money, not just about hitting activity targets

You want your pipeline handed to you.
You think prospecting stops the day you start closing.
Your best answer to “how did you perform?” is “the team hit target”.
Joblogic in thirty seconds
We are the UK’s #1 Field Service Management software platform. Founded in 1998, ~£35M ARR, 500+ people and over 100,000 users across HVAC, plumbing, electrical maintenance, facilities management and building fabric maintenance. We are backed by Vista Equity Partners with over £100 million of new capital behind us, and we are scaling to £100M ARR with an AI-first product roadmap.
Put simply: the market is huge, the product wins, and the ceiling on this team has just been lifted. We need people who want to run at that.

Send us your CV, and tell us in a few lines about the best opportunity you have ever self-sourced (In the Cover Letter). How you found it, how you got in, what happened next. We are far more interested in that than in how your CV is formatted.
Bring energy. This team runs on it.

THE JOB Warum mute-labs? Bei mute-labs gibt es weder „VC-getriebenen Burnout“ noch toxische Sales Floors. Wir sind ein eigenfinanziertes, nachhaltig profitables Team mit einer klaren Mission: mehr Ruhe in die lautesten Büros der Welt zu bringen.

Qualifizierte Inbound Leads: Vergiss wahlloses „Smile and Dial“. Du bist die erste Ansprechperson für hochwertige Leads – Unternehmen, die bereits echtes Interesse an unseren Produkten haben.

Kein Ellenbogen-Sales: Bei uns gibt es keine Provision. Warum? Weil wir möchten, dass Du das tust, was für den Kunden und das Team am besten ist – nicht das, was Deinen Bonus maximiert. Stattdessen bieten wir ein wettbewerbsfähiges, stabiles Fixgehalt, weil wir auf Deine intrinsische Motivation setzen.

11:00 | Strategy Huddle: Kurzer Austausch mit Alvaro, unserem Country Manager, oder Jarno, unserem Sales Director, zu einem konkreten Deal oder einem Markttrend, den Du entdeckt hast.
12:30 | Family Table: Wir essen gemeinsam. Freitags kocht ein Team für die ganze Firma. Ob Pasta, Tacos oder ein persönlicher Klassiker – beim gemeinsamen Mittagessen kommen wir als Team zusammen.
14:30 | Market Mastery: Du führst Discovery Demos. Dabei hörst Du mehr zu, als Du redest, und findest heraus, wo beim Kunden wirklich der Schuh drückt.
18:00 | The Close: Du bringst Dein CRM auf den neuesten Stand, aktualisierst Deine Pipeline und machst Feierabend. Deine Offline-Zeit respektieren wir.

**Deine Mission**
Als Account Manager B2B Sales bist du für den nachhaltigen Erfolg und die Weiterentwicklung deines eigenen Verkaufsgebiets verantwortlich.
Du gewinnst neue B2B\-Kunden, entwickelst bestehende Kundenbeziehungen weiter und erkennst gezielt neue Geschäftspotenziale. Dabei bist du die zentrale Ansprechperson für deine Kunden und entwickelst gemeinsam mit ihnen passende Lösungen für ihren individuellen Bedarf.
Du bist hauptsächlich bei deinen Kunden vor Ort und gestaltest deinen Arbeitsalltag eigenverantwortlich. Für fachliche Unterstützung und vertiefte Produktfragen stehen dir unsere Spezialisten aus den verschiedenen Produktbereichen zur Seite.
Mit viel Gestaltungsspielraum, Eigenverantwortung und unternehmerischem Denken entwickelst du dein Kundenportfolio kontinuierlich weiter und trägst aktiv zum Wachstum von Lyreco Schweiz bei.
**Was du bei uns bewegen kannst**
* Aktiver Verkauf unseres umfassenden Produkte\- und Dienstleistungsportfolios
* Gezielte und selbstständige Neukundenakquise
* Aufbau, Betreuung und kontinuierliche Weiterentwicklung deines eigenen B2B\-Kundenportfolios
* Identifikation und Ausschöpfung von Cross\- und Upselling\-Potenzialen
* Analyse deines Kundenportfolios und selbstständige Ableitung geeigneter Verkaufsmassnahmen
* Selbstständige Vorbereitung, Planung, Durchführung und Nachbearbeitung von Kundenbesuchen
* Führen von Preis\-, Konditions\- und Vertragsverhandlungen mit kleinen bis mittelgrossen Geschäftskunden
* Entwicklung individueller Lösungen auf Basis der Bedürfnisse und Anforderungen deiner Kunden
* Aktive Pflege und Ausbau langfristiger Kundenbeziehungen
* Koordination mit internen Fachabteilungen und unseren Produktspezialisten
* Konsequente Nachbearbeitung und Dokumentation deiner Kundenaktivitäten und Verkaufschancen
**Das bringst du mit**
* Abgeschlossene Grundausbildung im kaufmännischen, technischen oder Detailhandelsbereich
* Berufserfahrung im B2B\-Verkauf, idealerweise im Aussendienst
* Freude an der aktiven Neukundenakquise und am Aufbau langfristiger Kundenbeziehungen
* Ausgeprägte Erfolgs\- und Zielorientierung sowie den Mut, Chancen zu erkennen und aktiv zu nutzen
* Hohes Mass an Eigeninitiative, Selbstständigkeit und Verantwortungsbewusstsein
* Kundenorientiertes und unternehmerisches Denken
* Vernetzte Denkweise sowie eine strukturierte und organisierte Arbeitsweise
* Kommunikationsstärke und sicheres Auftreten im Umgang mit unterschiedlichen Ansprechpartnern
* Affinität für digitale Tools und MS Office; gute Excel\-Kenntnisse
* Wohnsitz in der Region und gültiger Führerausweis Kategorie B
**Auf das kannst du dich freuen**
* Eine selbstständige und abwechslungsreiche Sales\-Tätigkeit mit viel Gestaltungsspielraum
* Ein internationales Unternehmen mit starken lokalen Wurzeln in der Schweiz
* Firmenwagen oder attraktive Autopauschale für deine Tätigkeit im Aussendienst
* Ein offenes, menschenzentriertes und multikulturelles Arbeitsumfeld
* Ein Team, in dem Zusammenarbeit, gegenseitige Unterstützung und gemeinsame Erfolge zählen

s.t:
Client Management
Operates as lead point of contact on assigned projects within the client account as determined by Account Supervisor

At least one year of experience as an Assistant Account Executive or Account Executive within an advertising, marketing, communication or related industry.
Proficient in Microsoft Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and Outlook
Flexibility for possible travel up to 5%
Medical communications or healthcare industry experience is a plus
Experience with writing SOWs and project briefs, as well as the ability to contribute to the development of strategic documents is preferred, but not required.

Secure Every Identity, from AI to Human
Identity is the key to unlocking the potential of AI. Okta secures AI by building the trusted, neutral infrastructure that enables organizations to safely embrace this new era. This work requires a relentless drive to solve complex challenges with real-world stakes. We are looking for builders and owners who operate with speed and urgency and execute with excellence.
This is an opportunity to do career-defining work. We're all in on this mission. If you are too, let's talk.
Are you ready to redefine the future of digital identity in the AI era?
Okta’s UKI Strategic Account Executive Sales Team is hiring!
Our Strategic Account Executives (SAE) are the visionary leaders who orchestrate and drive sales engagements for our most critical and prestigious UKI customers.
In an era where Artificial Intelligence is transforming how enterprises operate, identity has become the new security perimeter. As an SAE, you won't just be selling software—you will act as a trusted, long-term advisor helping the C-suite safely navigate the AI revolution.

You will build first-class Account Plans that map directly to your customers' overarching business strategies, digital transformation initiatives, and AI adoption plans.

By championing value-based selling, you will translate complex technical capabilities into undeniable business outcomes, showing how secure identity is the ultimate enabler of modern enterprise innovation and ROI.
You will collaboratively plan and orchestrate the execution of aligned account strategies, ensuring robust opportunity generation, deep relationship alignment, and flawless account governance. Expect to lead from the front: presenting Okta’s transformational proposals, negotiating high-stakes terms, and bringing down complex, multi-layered, seven-figure deals that deliver massive win-win scenarios for both the customer and Okta.
Beyond managing existing relationships, you will hunt for new business leads that fit our ideal client profile, uncovering uncharted territory in the market. You will align closely with our Global partners to build sustainable strategic engagements, and leverage cutting-edge Account-Based Marketing to ensure Okta's investment continuously aligns with customer growth.
We are seeking a passionate, strategic, and hyper-focused professional to drive massive new revenue growth across Fortune 500 accounts. As an individual contributor, you will play a vital, high-visibility role in driving a significant share of revenue for Okta, helping the world's most prominent enterprises transition securely into a smarter, AI-driven future.
We provide our reps with an environment where they can make incredibly valuable contributions from day one, while also building endless opportunities for learning and career growth. The work you do here will directly impact the security, trust, and digital experience of the world's largest organizations.

s.h: As an Okta Strategic Account Executive, you will
s.t:
Establish a Vision: Create and execute a master plan to guide your long-term, strategic approach to the premier accounts assigned in your Territory.
Master Value Selling: Deeply understand your clients' business goals and tie Okta's solutions directly to their strategic imperatives, continuously selling on business value and ROI rather than just features.
Orchestrate Complex Deals: Navigate and close highly complex, multi-stakeholder, seven-figure deals, bringing together cross-functional teams to deliver transformational outcomes.
Enable Secure AI Transformation: Partner with clients to position identity as the critical foundation for their AI initiatives, ensuring they can safely deploy AI agents, automate workflows, and manage machine-to-machine identities without compromising security.
Expand & Deepen: Land, adopt, expand, and entrench sales opportunities within Fortune 500 accounts across your region.
Navigate the Org Chart: Explore the full spectrum of relationships and business possibilities across the client’s entire organizational structure, from technical buyers to the CIO, CISO, and Board of Directors.
Be a Thought Leader: Become the definitive authority on Okta’s platform, the vertical in which you are aligned, and the evolving security requirements of the modern, AI-first enterprise.
Leverage the Ecosystem: Holistically embrace, access, and utilize our channel and alliance partners to identify and crack open new, uncharted opportunities.
Collaborate to Win: Work as a unified team for the most efficient deployment of resources, providing timely and insightful input back to other corporate functions.
Champion the Platform: Represent Okta to prospective clients at executive sales presentations, site visits, and high-impact product demonstrations.
Build Partnerships: Cultivate highly effective working partnerships with your Okta colleagues globally (channel partners, sales engineering, business value management, customer first, etc.) with both humility and relentless enthusiasm.

s.h: You could be a great fit for this role if you have
s.t:
Proven Experience: A highly consistent track record in strategic field sales, specifically developing new logos and selling enterprise cloud software to Fortune 500 companies.
Complex Deal Expertise: A proven track record of successfully navigating, negotiating, and closing highly complex, six-to-seven-figure software cloud deals with prospects and customers in the defined territory.
Value-Selling Mastery: Deep experience with target account selling, solution selling, and consultative sales techniques that focus on business value. (Knowledge of MEDDIC, Challenger methodologies, or similar frameworks is a massive plus!)
Forward-Looking Tech IQ: A solid understanding of how modern technologies, automation, and AI are reshaping enterprise security, data access, and cloud architectures.
Ecosystem Leverage: Previous success utilizing partners, channels, and alliances to sell more effectively and obliterate your quota.
Domain Knowledge: Experience selling complex cloud solutions in areas like enterprise Cloud/SaaS software, identity/security, infrastructure management, application development, or modern data platforms.
Market Creation Skills: A measurable track record in new business development and over-achieving sales targets, especially in high-growth, fast-changing environments or during market creation phases.
Executive Presence: Deep experience engaging with the “C” suite, possessing strong executive presence, immense polish, and world-class listening skills.

Enterprise Account Executive
Location: North America — Remote
Hybrid Option: Columbus, OH
Reports To: VP of Sales
Compensation: $120,000 base salary, commensurate with experience, plus uncapped commission
Focus: Net-New Enterprise Logos | Utilities | Telecom | Critical Infrastructure Risk Prevention
Opportunity
If you want to build the executive relationships that protect the pipelines, grids, and networks the country runs on — and you thrive on closing transformational enterprise deals — you’ll thrive here.
Irth Solutions builds advanced technology that empowers the individuals who keep our lights on, water running, and pipelines flowing. Our solutions enhance the safety, reliability, and efficiency of critical infrastructure and the field technicians, engineers, and analysts who operate it.
We are looking for a senior Enterprise Account Executive to lead our net-new enterprise sales efforts across energy, utilities, telecom, and critical infrastructure asset protection.
This is a true hunter role focused on identifying, pursuing, and closing large, complex enterprise opportunities. You will target marquee “white whale” accounts across North America — organizations where a single enterprise agreement can establish a long-term, multi-product relationship.
The ideal candidate is an executive-level communicator who can command a conversation with an operator, VP of Operations, CIO, CRO, COO, or CEO and translate Irth Solutions’ technology into measurable business, safety, operational, and risk outcomes.
Success in this role is measured not only by winning the initial enterprise deal, but by structuring each relationship to create opportunities for long-term cross-sell and upsell growth.

Lead the full sales cycle for net-new, enterprise-scale opportunities across energy, utilities, telecom, and critical infrastructure asset protection, including electric, gas, water, and telecom.
Focus on the largest and highest-value target accounts in the North American market.
Build and maintain relationships with C-level and senior operational executives, including COOs, CIOs, CROs, and VPs of Operations.
Position Irth Solutions as a strategic, enterprise-wide platform rather than a point solution.
Apply advanced value-selling techniques to help executive buyers understand the operational, financial, safety, and risk impact of Irth Solutions.
Develop and execute account-based, multi-year strategic plans for landing flagship enterprise logos.
Create clear post-close strategies for cross-sell and upsell opportunities, turning enterprise accounts into long-term growth engines.
Partner closely with Customer Success, Solutions Engineering, Product, and other internal teams to develop enterprise-ready proposals, pricing structures, and contract terms.
Develop a deep understanding of Irth Solutions’ business development philosophy, pricing models, proposal methodology, and enterprise sales process.
Maintain strong knowledge of the competitive landscape and Irth Solutions’ positioning within utilities, telecom, energy, and critical infrastructure risk prevention.
Source and cultivate executive-level relationships, referrals, and strategic connections to build a sustainable enterprise pipeline.
Gather and present detailed business, technical, operational, and risk information to support proposals, underwriting, and executive presentations.
Maintain accurate sales activity, pipeline, opportunity, and forecasting information within Salesforce CRM.
Represent customer needs and strategic objectives internally to ensure a coordinated, high-touch enterprise experience.
Attend industry seminars, trainings, conferences, and events as required.
Adhere to company policies, procedures, business ethics standards, and applicable regulatory requirements.
What Success Looks Like
Consistently build a strong pipeline of high-value, net-new enterprise opportunities.
Establish trusted relationships with senior executives and key decision-makers.
Close transformational, multi-year enterprise agreements.
Expand initial enterprise wins into broader, multi-product relationships.
Accurately forecast enterprise opportunities and maintain disciplined CRM hygiene.
Become a trusted advisor to customers navigating operational, safety, infrastructure, and risk challenges.
Help establish Irth Solutions as a strategic technology partner across critical infrastructure organizations.

You are a senior enterprise sales professional who is energized by complex deals, executive relationships, and large strategic accounts. You know how to hunt, create opportunities where none previously existed, navigate complex buying committees, and build consensus across multiple stakeholders.
You are comfortable selling to sophisticated organizations where deals may involve operations, IT, risk, finance, procurement, and executive leadership. You understand that enterprise selling is about more than demonstrating product features — it is about connecting technology to measurable business outcomes.
You bring a combination of strategic account planning, executive presence, value selling, persistence, and commercial discipline.

7+ years of proven, quota-carrying enterprise or strategic account executive experience , with a consistent track record of sourcing and closing large, complex, multi-year SaaS agreements.
Demonstrated experience selling into energy, utilities, telecom, or critical infrastructure damage and risk prevention , including electric, gas, water, or telecom. Must have the domain fluency and credibility to earn the trust of operators and executive decision-makers.
Executive presence and gravitas , with the ability to lead business conversations, influence stakeholders, and close deals at the C-suite and operator level. You should be someone Irth Solutions can confidently put in front of a CEO or senior infrastructure operator.
Proven success selling SaaS solutions and business value propositions through consultative and solution-selling approaches into large, complex, matrixed organizations.
Track record of structuring enterprise agreements to create durable cross-sell and upsell opportunities and drive long-term account growth.
Excellent verbal and written executive communication skills , including the ability to chair meetings, lead executive briefings, deliver presentations, and host webinars.
Strong organizational and time-management skills , with the ability to multi-thread relationships and manage multiple long, complex enterprise sales cycles simultaneously.
Comfortable operating in a high-growth, fast-paced environment with a diverse enterprise customer base and highly differentiated customer needs.
Existing network and credibility within utility, telecom, critical infrastructure damage prevention, asset protection, or risk management functions is strongly preferred.
Based in North America , with the ability and willingness to travel as needed for prospect meetings, customer engagements, conferences, and industry events.
Bachelor’s degree or equivalent relevant experience.

KAYAK, part of Booking Holdings (NASDAQ: BKNG), is a leading travel search engine. With billions of queries across our platforms, we help people find their perfect flight, stay, rental car and vacation package. We're also transforming business travel with a new corporate travel solution, KAYAK for Business.
As an employee of KAYAK, you will be part of a travel company that operates a portfolio of global metasearch brands including momondo, Cheapflights and HotelsCombined, among others. From start-up to industry leader, innovation is in our DNA and every employee has an opportunity to make their mark. Our focus is on building the best travel search engine to make it easier for everyone to experience the world.
We're looking for a Senior Account Manager to join KAYAK for Business — a growing corporate travel platform where account management sits at the heart of client success and commercial growth.

In this role, you'll own a portfolio of clients across Europe and globally, working closely with travel managers, internal product and engineering teams, and travel management company (TMC) partners to build travel programmes that genuinely work for the people using them.

You'll be the connective tissue between client needs and KAYAK's capabilities — turning insights into action, and relationships into long-term partnerships.
This role is based in our London office 3 times a week.

Own a portfolio of KAYAK for Business clients — from global enterprise companies to SMB growth accounts — with a focus on retention, adoption, satisfaction, and long-term success
Serve as the primary contact for client teams, building trusted relationships and aligning the travel programme to their business goals
Lead the negotiation and contracting process for amendments and renewals
Drive account strategy and governance through regular reviews, performance insights, and clear action plans
Partner with client teams and TMC partners to optimise programme setup, workflows, and traveller experience
Use data to identify risks, opportunities, and recommendations that improve adoption, performance, and overall programme results
Coordinate across internal teams — including product, engineering, finance, and customer support — to resolve complex issues, drive improvements, and advance client priorities
Manage escalations, product changes, invoicing, and operational matters with strong ownership and follow-through
Represent client needs internally, helping shape product priorities and service improvements
Support geographical expansion by coordinating market rollouts and keeping all parties aligned across regions.

Experience in account management, ideally in corporate travel, B2B SaaS, or a related client-facing environment; equivalent experience, training, or transferable skills are welcome
A client-first mindset, sound problem-solving skills, and a hands-on approach to addressing issues and identifying opportunities
Comfort working across time zones — you will report into the global Account Management team in the US and collaborate with colleagues across Europe and the US
Experience engaging senior contacts on both the client and internal sides, and working alongside product and engineering teams
A collaborative working style and enjoyment of cross-functional work
Strong written and verbal communication skills, including experience presenting to clients or senior audiences
Fluency in English (written and spoken); a second European language is a plus
Comfort working with data and presentation tools (e.g. Google Workspace, Excel, PowerPoint); experience with CRM platforms such as Salesforce is a plus
Willingness to travel approximately 15–20% as needed

5 weeks of paid vacation
Generous paid vacation + time off for your birthday
Private health & dental insurance
Income protection and life assurance
Pension plan contributions
Work from (almost) anywhere for up to 20 days per year

Die Firma Rohrbogen AG ist ein international tätiges Familienunternehmen mit Standorten in der Schweiz und in Polen. Die hochwertigen Produkte vertreibt sie weltweit mit einem europäischen Fokus. Dabei schätzen Kunden das umfangreiche Know\-how und die Flexibilität bei der Produktion von Rohrbogen und Formteilen aus Edelstahl für die Bereiche Industrie, Chemie, Pharmazie, Lebensmittel sowie Fahrzeug\- und Apparatebau.
Leiter/in Technischer Verkauf (m/w/d \| 80\-100%)
=================================================
Als Leiter/In technischer Verkauf verbindest du deine Begeisterung für den Vertrieb mit technischem Know\-How. Deine Hauptaufgabe besteht darin, die Verkaufsstrategie für den technischen Verkauf weiterzuentwickeln und mit uns gemeinsam die Zukunft zu gestalten. Dabei stehen dir alle Möglichkeiten offen, Verantwortung zu übernehmen und deine Fähigkeiten in einem dynamischen Umfeld weiterzuentwickeln.
### Deine Aufgaben
* Technische neue Produkte: Du bearbeitest neue Anfragen, klärst Anforderungen und beurteilst gemeinsam mit unserem technischen Team die technische Machbarkeit und erarbeitest die kommerziellen Angebote bis zur Auftragsvergabe.
* Projektleitung: Du führst und motivierst das technische Projektteam bei neuen Kundenprojekten vom ersten Entwurf über Muster und Erstmuster bis zur erfolgreichen Serienauslieferung. Bei technischen oder terminlichen Herausforderungen koordinierst du die notwendigen Abklärungen, fasst konsequent nach und begleitest Lösungen bis zum Abschluss.
* Schnittstellenkoordination: Du arbeitest eng mit Technik, Produktion, Einkauf und unseren Produktionsstandorten zusammen und stellst einen reibungslosen Informationsfluss sicher.
* Kundenbetreuung: Du bist technische Ansprechperson für unsere Kunden, baust bestehende Beziehungen weiter aus und unterstützt bei der Entwicklung neuer Geschäftsmöglichkeiten.
* Strategische Verkaufsplanung: Verantwortung für die Entwicklung und Umsetzung von Verkaufsstrategien zur Steigerung des Umsatzes und Marktanteils.
* Budget\- und Zielverantwortung: Erstellung und Kontrolle von Verkaufsbudgets, Sicherstellung der Erreichung von Umsatz\- und Profitzielen.
### Dein Profil
* Technische Grundausbildung von Vorteil, idealerweise ergänzt durch eine Weiterbildung auf Stufe HF/FH oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation
* Mehrjährige Erfahrung im technischen Verkauf
* Ausgeprägtes technisches Verständnis und Freude daran, technische Lösungen gemeinsam mit Kunden und internen Fachstellen zu entwickeln
* Interesse am Verkauf und daran, dich im technischen Vertrieb weiterzuentwickeln
* Freude an Kundenkontakt, Projektarbeit und bereichsübergreifender Zusammenarbeit
* Selbständige, strukturierte und lösungsorientierte Arbeitsweise
* Kommunikationsstärke und die Fähigkeit, technische Zusammenhänge verständlich zu vermitteln
* Führungserfahrung ist nicht erforderlich, wichtiger sind für uns dein Potenzial, deine Motivation und deine Bereitschaft, Verantwortung zu übernehmen
### Das bieten wir dir
Bei uns erwartet dich keine klassische Verkaufsstelle, bei der du vom ersten Tag an nur Umsatzzahlen hinterherläufst. Stattdessen erhältst du die Möglichkeit, unsere Produkte, Prozesse und Kunden von Grund auf kennenzulernen und dich Schritt für Schritt in eine verantwor\-tungsvolle Funktion im technischen Verkauf zu entwickeln.
Wir bieten dir viel Gestaltungsspielraum, kurze Entscheidungswege und die Möglichkeit, deine technischen Kenntnisse mit Verkauf, Projektmanagement und später auch Führungsverantwortung zu verbinden.

At Harvey, the future of professional services is being written today — and we’re just getting started.
